title: Build custom InSpec resources for OCI profile
description:
Build custom InSpec resources to eliminate 1,500+ lines of duplicated code across 40+ controls.

Following official MITRE SAF TDD workflow and inspec-aws architecture patterns:

Tier 1 (Foundation):
- oci_regions (15+ controls, 120 lines saved)
- oci_compartments (20+ controls, 300+ lines saved)
- OciBackend base classes

Tier 2 (Major Impact):
- oci_event_rules (5 controls, 500 lines saved - highest single impact)
- oci_security_lists (4 controls, 400 lines saved)
- oci_buckets (4 controls, 140 lines saved)

Tier 3 (Specialized):
- oci_identity_domain_password_policy (6 controls)
- oci_network_security_groups (2 controls)
- oci_vault_keys (1 control)
- OciFindings helper module (all 54 controls)

Net impact: ~745 line reduction with better maintainability, caching, testability.

title: Phase 5: Build storage resources (200 line reduction)
description:
Build storage resources for bucket compliance checks.

oci_buckets / oci_bucket:
- FilterTable with .where(region:)
- Bucket attributes: public?, versioning, kms_key_id, logging_enabled?
- Custom matchers: have_public_buckets, all_use_customer_managed_keys
- Used in controls 4.17, 5.1.1, 5.1.2, 5.1.3
- 140 lines eliminated

oci_vault_keys:
- Enumerate keys across vaults with age calculation
- FilterTable with .where { enabled && age_days > 365 }
- Used in control 4.16
- 60 lines eliminated

Reference: aws_s3_bucket/aws_s3_buckets for bucket pattern

title: Phase 4: Build networking resources (400 line reduction)
description:
Build networking resources for security list/NSG ingress rule analysis.

oci_security_lists / oci_security_list:
- FilterTable with ingress rule filtering
- Methods: allows_ingress_from_internet?(port:), public_ports
- Used in controls 2.1, 2.2
- 200 lines eliminated

oci_network_security_groups / oci_network_security_group:
- Parallel structure to security_lists
- Used in controls 2.3, 2.4
- 200 lines eliminated

After implementation, refactor 4 networking controls.

Reference: INSPEC_RESOURCE_PATTERNS.md FilterTable with custom matchers

title: Phase 3: Build oci_event_rules (500 line reduction)
description:
Build oci_event_rules resource - HIGHEST IMPACT (500 lines eliminated).

Controls 4.10, 4.11, 4.12, 4.15, 4.18 all repeat identical 100-line event rule validation pattern.

oci_event_rules (plural):
- FilterTable with .where(region:, enabled:)
- Methods: has_rule_matching_conditions?(event_types), has_active_ons_topic?(name)
- Validates event types from JSON condition
- Checks ONS actions and topic state

oci_event_rule (singular):
- Attributes: enabled?, event_types, ons_topics
- Parse JSON condition from rule details
- Fetch and validate ONS topic metadata

After implementation, refactor 5 controls to use new resource.

Reference: INSPEC_RESOURCE_PATTERNS.md FilterTable patterns, aws_s3_bucket example

title: Phase 2: Build oci_regions and oci_compartments
description:
Implement oci_regions and oci_compartments as reference implementations.

oci_regions (plural):
- FilterTable with .names, .count
- Caches region-subscription list API call
- Used by 15+ controls

oci_compartments (plural):
- FilterTable with .ids, .names, .name_for(id) lookup
- Includes root compartment
- Caches compartment list API call
- Used by 20+ controls

Follow TDD: Write control syntax first, implement after. Test in inspec shell.

Reference: INSPEC_RESOURCE_PATTERNS.md Appendix A (FilterTable), ip6tables example
